changes: No persons, date or place added; notes expanded on the damaged line 'sarabhaśaka ... ntisattaḥ', which may be a garbled date or scribe statement (e.g. a Śaka year) but is not recoverable

notes: The only colophon is the chapter colophon: adhyāya 166, Bhīṣmasvargārohaṇa, in the Dānadharma section. The text calls it 'śāṃtiparvaṇi uttamānuśāsike', but this is the final chapter of the Anuśāsanaparvan. After it comes a corrupt passage with a lacuna, 'sarabhaśaka (!) .... ntisattaḥ (!)'. This might once have held a date, perhaps with 'śaka', or a scribal statement, but no name, era, year or place can be recovered from it. The physical manuscript should be checked at fol. 204r9–12.
